prompt_spec.wink: friendly single-eye wink with an otherwise familiar pose
prompt_spec.not_me: neutral curious head tilt with an upward glance, relaxed asymmetric brow, and tiny thoughtful mouth; never sad
prompt_spec.warm_smile: calm seated or naturally settled eyes-closed smile
prompt_spec.celebrate: unmistakably airborne joyful pose with raised limbs as anatomy permits

generation_layout: square 2x2 sheet on flat #00FF00 chroma key with no dividers, text, shadows, props, or detached effects
post_processing: chroma removal, quadrant extraction, then canonical center and extent normalization with scripts/normalize_eguchi_reaction_assets.py
